manuscript_claim: PPS Toolkit is a Behavior Research Methods-style methods/software suite paper, not a new participant-effect paper.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Springer/BRM fit; same-journal comparator rationale; software/method workflow and reusable artifacts.
current_source_evidence: main.tex contribution/journal-fit section; brm_comparator_articles.csv; critical_review.md; submission_readiness_audit.md.
safe_submission_phrasing: PPS Toolkit is presented as a methods/software suite for designing, running, validating, and recreating audio-tactile PPS experiments.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: PPS Toolkit proves a new PPS effect or resolves theoretical disagreements about PPS boundaries.
next_required_artifact: Final human copy edit plus final release/declaration metadata.

manuscript_claim: The literature work is an evidence matrix of design decisions, not a formal meta-analysis.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Explicit review boundary; source-pointer matrix; no PRISMA/effect-size claims.
current_source_evidence: main.tex introduction and reporting checklist; evidence_matrix.csv; submission_readiness_audit.md formal meta-analysis row.
safe_submission_phrasing: The manuscript uses a structured evidence matrix to map GUI decisions to methodological variation in the literature.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The manuscript is a systematic review or meta-analysis of audio-tactile PPS effects.
next_required_artifact: PRISMA-style protocol, screening log, extracted effect sizes, and synthesis code if this claim is ever desired.

manuscript_claim: Visible Segment 0-6 methods decisions are represented in the evidence/control ledgers.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Source audit of current dashboard controls; literature-bearing controls mapped to matrix rows; operational UI separated from methods choices.
safe_submission_phrasing: Every visible Segment 0-6 methods decision in the audited dashboard source is represented in the control ledger and, where literature-bearing, in the evidence matrix.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: Every visual element or future dashboard edit is permanently covered without re-audit.
next_required_artifact: Rerun control/source audit after any dashboard control change; add visual/click validation for GUI usability claims.

manuscript_claim: The toolkit is a suite for designing, running, validating, and recreating/scaffolding PPS experiments.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Manuscript sections covering design workflow, profile recreation, native runner handoff, evidence tiers, and exploratory analysis.
current_source_evidence: main.tex title, abstract, Design Run and Recreation Pathway, technical method, validation/use cases; submission_readiness_audit.md.
safe_submission_phrasing: The toolkit provides a segmented design-run-recreation workflow with separate evidence layers.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The toolkit is submission-ready as a fully validated acquisition platform for all hardware routes.
next_required_artifact: Release DOI/commit, final validation archive, and publication-hardware run artifacts.

manuscript_claim: Profiles can recreate or scaffold reported PPS paradigms as auditable configurations.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Source-paper fields, represented/missing field ledger, rights/substitution ledger, Segment 6 materialization evidence.
current_source_evidence: profile_family_examples.csv; validation_evidence.csv Protocol 12 row; main.tex profile-family table and caveats.
safe_submission_phrasing: Profiles represent reported timing, direction, baseline, and runner-handoff fields where source evidence is available, with missing fields and substitutions caveated.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: Profiles exactly replicate original apparatus, private stimuli, and participant effects across all listed studies.
next_required_artifact: Profile-specific source audit, rights ledger, apparatus notes, original-stimulus availability or substitution validation.

manuscript_claim: The bundled Study 5-style workflow can be used as a runnable example of the suite.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Segment 0-6 materialization, runner package preparation, source manifests, block schedules, validation report, artifact hashes.

safe_submission_phrasing: A Study 5-style profile demonstrates Segment 0-6 materialization and runner handoff.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The example validates final physical timing, tactile mechanics, or participant-level PPS effects.

manuscript_claim: Burst-train and smooth/continuous looming source choices are first-class design decisions with literature variation.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Evidence matrix rows; source-profile metadata; generated assets and hashes; source-mode documentation.
current_source_evidence: evidence_matrix.csv; gui_control_coverage.csv; main.tex Auditory Ingredients; For-AI looming standard.
safe_submission_phrasing: The toolkit exposes burst-train and smooth-linear source modes because PPS studies use different auditory source forms.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: Burst train is universally superior or equivalent to all previous looming stimuli.
next_required_artifact: Profile-specific stimulus validation, perceptual salience checks, and source-rights review.

manuscript_claim: Loudness policy is a methods decision distinct from measured SPL evidence.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Gain/loudness metadata, default estimate caveat, physical measurement requirements.
current_source_evidence: main.tex Auditory Ingredients and technical method; evidence_matrix.csv loudness row; For-AI/loudness_calibration.md.

safe_submission_phrasing: The toolkit records loudness policy and estimated route metadata; participant-ear SPL claims require measurement.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The default estimate is a publication-grade SPL calibration.

manuscript_claim: SOFA/FABIAN/3DTI metadata provide reproducible rendering provenance, not perceived-distance proof.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Renderer metadata; HRTF/SOFA source notes; local perceptual or localization validation for strong claims.
current_source_evidence: main.tex Spatial Audio and HRTF Resources; evidence_matrix.csv; procedural_gap_register.csv.
current_status: source-ready for provenance; blocked for perception
safe_submission_phrasing: The toolkit records SOFA/HRTF/rendering provenance and separates it from perceived distance or externalization evidence.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: HRTF metadata proves that participants perceived the intended distance, direction, or externalization.
next_required_artifact: Spatial-route validation, localization/externalization checks, individualized-HRTF evidence if claimed.

manuscript_claim: Tactile thresholding, misses, top-up, and adaptation safeguards are methods decisions; the 70 percent hit-rate observation is anecdotal unless artifacts are supplied.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Calibration artifacts, participant/run traces, analysis code, hit-rate plots, condition/time controls.
current_source_evidence: main.tex tactile calibration prose; evidence_matrix.csv; submission_readiness_audit.md; procedural_gap_register.csv.
safe_submission_phrasing: Pilot observations motivated run-local safeguards; quantitative hit-rate decline is not reported without traceable artifacts.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: Tactile calibration inevitably causes a 70 percent hit rate or proves habituation in the reported task.
next_required_artifact: Traceable run folder, deidentified trial data, adaptive-threshold logs, analysis script, and ethics/data-sharing language.

manuscript_claim: After every two tactile misses, the runner raises Output 3/4 by 0.01 percentage points up to 0.5 percent and logs artifacts.
evidence_needed_for_strong_claim: Runner behavior evidence, event names, artifact schema, validation traces; empirical test if claiming efficacy.
current_source_evidence: main.tex technical method; submission_readiness_audit.md; For-AI project context.
safe_submission_phrasing: The adaptive nudge is an operator safeguard with logged artifacts, not a validated psychophysical correction.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The adaptive nudge corrects tactile habituation or guarantees unbiased hit rates.
next_required_artifact: Empirical validation of response completeness and condition/time bias.

safe_submission_phrasing: The toolkit materializes inspectable repetition pools, block schedules, and participant-order artifacts.
unsafe_or_premature_phrasing: The generated schedule alone proves behavioral validity or adequate power.
next_required_artifact: Final example archive with seeds, block CSVs, participant order files, and planned sample-size rationale.
